nyhavn.name: Nyhavn
nyhavn.slogan: Painted houses, cold beer and masts at the old harbour's edge.
nyhavn.line: Hans Christian Andersen lived at three addresses here, No. 67 for 19 years, in a canal dug by soldiers and Swedish prisoners of war.

tivoli.name: Tivoli Gardens
tivoli.slogan: Lanterns, lakes and a wooden coaster in the middle of town.
tivoli.line: Tivoli opened on 15 August 1843, and its wooden roller coaster Rutschebanen has been running since 1914.

littlemermaid.name: The Little Mermaid
littlemermaid.slogan: A small bronze lady who keeps watch over a big harbour.
littlemermaid.line: Unveiled in 1913 and just 1.25 metres tall, she was modelled on sculptor Edvard Eriksen's wife, Eline.

kronborg.name: Kronborg Castle
kronborg.slogan: Renaissance towers guarding the narrowest point of the Sound.
kronborg.line: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.
kronborg.by: Marcellus, in Shakespeare's Hamlet, Act 1 Scene 4

roskildedom.name: Roskilde Cathedral
roskildedom.slogan: Brick spires over a thousand years of Danish kings.
roskildedom.line: One of Scandinavia's earliest brick Gothic cathedrals, it has been the main royal burial site since the 15th century and a World Heritage Site since 1995.
